title: WBCAP Merit List 2026 Out, 1st Seat Allotment PDF at wbcap.in,, Admission Dates and Process
fullContentHtml:
WBCAP Merit List 2026 has been released on 9 June 2026 through the West Bengal Centralised Admission Portal @wbcap.in. Candidates who submitted the CAP Application form can now check selection status online. The merit list is available on the official portal and respective college websites. Admission to undergraduate courses will be granted based on Class 12 marks and institution wise merit list prepared by participating Higher Education Institutions (HEIs). Candidates whose names appear in the merit list must complete admission process between 9 June and 15 June 2026. Read below to know more about WBCAP Merit List 2026 PDF download link, admission schedule, important instructions and more.

WBCAP Merit List 2026 Out

WBCAP Merit List 2026 has been released for candidates seeking admission to undergraduate courses. Students can check merit list on the official portal @wbcap.in. The list has been prepared based on Class 12 examination marks. Candidates who have secured a place in merit list can proceed with admission process within prescribed dates i.e., 9 June to 15 June 2026.

How to Download WBCAP Merit List 2026?

Candidates can check and download WBCAP Merit List 2026 through the official admission portal. Candidates need login credentials and must select college for which they applied. Follow the steps below to access merit list.

  • Visit the official WBCAP Portal @wbcap.in
  • Log in using registered credentials
  • Click on merit list tab available on the homepage
  • Select the university and college applied for
  • College wise merit list will appear on the screen
  • Download merit list PDF for future reference
  • Search for name or application number in list.

Download WBJEE College/University List PDF

Details Mentioned on WBCAP Merit List 2026

After downloading WBCAP Merit List 2026 candidates should carefully verify all information mentioned in it. The merit list contains personal, academic and admission related details that will be used during the admission process. The following details are mentioned on the merit list.

  • Name of candidate
  • Category
  • Date of Birth
  • Subjects studies in Class 12
  • Marks obtained in Class 12 Board Examination
  • Merit Marks
  • College Name
  • University Name
  • Academic Session

WBCAP Seat Allocation List 2026

WBCAP Seat Allocation List 2026 has been released along with merit list on 9 June 2026. Candidates can check the allotment status by logging in to the official portal. The seat allocation list contains details of the college and course allotted to candidates. Students must download and keep a copy of the allotment letter. The letter will be required during physical verification and admission process.

What’s Next After WBCAP Merit List 2026?

After the release of WBCAP Merit List 2026 selected candidates must complete admission process within the prescribed time. Students need to pay the admission fee through respective college portal using online payment methods. They must also upload requisite documents for verification. Colleges will announce schedule for physical document verification on official website. Admission will be confirmed only after successful verification of documents.

WBCAP Cut Off 2026

WBCAP Cut Off 2026 will be released by participating colleges after publication of merit list. The cut off marks will vary across colleges, courses and categories. Colleges will prepare cut off based on Class 12 performance generally considering the best five subjects of the qualifying examination.

WBCAP Merit List 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was WBCAP Merit List 2026 released?

The merit list has been released on 9 June 2026 through the official portal @wbcap.in.

Q2. How can I check WBCAP Merit List 2026?

Candidates can check merit list by visiting the WBCAP Portal, logging in with credentials and selecting university and college.

Q3. What is the basis of preparing WBCAP 2026 Merit List?

The merit list has been prepared based on the marks obtained in Class 12 Board Examination.

Q4. What is the last date to complete the admission process?

Candidates whose names appear in merit list can complete admission process between 9 June and 15 June 2026.

Q5. What details are mentioned in WBCAP Seat Allocation List 2026?

The seat allocation list contains details such as allotted college, course, candidate information and admission status
